lines.en: label makotospring5:
scene nightsky
I’ve been thinking a lot lately about what I’d say to Maki if I ever see her again.
lines.zh: 我最近一直在想，如果还能再见到 Maki，我该对她说什么。

lines.en: Unfortunately, pretty much any progress I’ve made on that front has gone out the window considering that she is now apparently a part of something far more complicated than who I put my penis inside of.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我在这方面的进展基本全白费了——考虑到她现在显然卷进了一件远比「我把阴茎放进了谁的身体」更复杂的事情。

lines.en: And I trust Makoto to handle that, sure.
lines.zh: 我当然相信 Makoto 能处理好。

lines.en: I just don’t think that any amount of {i}handling{/i} will be able to convince Maki at all. So it’s mostly just a matter of time now and that makes things come full circle and get all confusing again.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得不管怎么{i}处理{/i}，都不可能说服 Maki。所以现在基本上只是时间问题，而这样一来事情就绕回原点，又变得一团乱了。

lines.en: Regardless, I’m outside of the porn shop right now and hoping that Maki will come outside and accidentally encounter me.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我现在就站在色情店外面，盼着 Maki 会走出来、偶然撞见我。

lines.en: I’m not really sure what I’ll do if she {i}does.{/i} But it’s enough to make me feel as if I’m contributing and that’s really all life is about sometimes.
lines.zh: 她{i}真出来了{/i}我要做什么，我也不太清楚。但这足以让我觉得自己正在出力，而有时候人生也就是这么回事。

lines.en: {size=-4}Occasionally, you help things progress. Occasionally, you slow them down. And occasionally, you get caught sleeping with your friend’s teenage daughter and then have to explain to her that it’s okay because time is infinite and she is immortal.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}偶尔，你推动事情前进。偶尔，你拖慢它们。偶尔，你被抓到和朋友十几岁的女儿上床，然后还得向她解释这没关系，因为时间无限，而她是不朽的。{/size}

lines.en: Whatever the case, I need to-
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我得——

lines.en: Hold on a second. I need to take this.
lines.zh: 等一下。我得接个电话。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}Sensei, come quick! We have another code red! And this time, it’s the one you mentioned yesterday!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Sensei，快来！又一个红色警报！而且这次是你昨天提到的那个！{/i}

lines.en: : Why do we have multiple code reds? There are so many other colors.
lines.zh: : 我们为什么有好几种红色警报？明明还有那么多别的颜色。

lines.en: : {i}I’ll tell you after you help me get out of this cage.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等你把我从这个笼子里弄出来我再告诉你。{/i}

lines.en: : It’s supposed to be a wall. A cage is a different, more realistic fetish where you get to look at me while I’m having sex with you instead of just wondering who’s using your lower half for their own personal gain.
lines.zh: : 按理说应该是墙才对。笼子是另一种更写实的癖好——你能看着我跟你做爱，而不是只能纳闷到底是谁在拿你的下半身谋私利。

lines.en: : {i}Help. The cage is suddenly a wall. Half of my body is so vulnerable right now. I sure hope no one uses it for their own personal gain.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}救命。笼子突然变成墙了。我现在半个身子都毫无防备。我真希望没人拿它来谋私利。{/i}

lines.en: : Say no more. I’m on the way. Where are-
lines.zh: : 不用说了。我这就过去。你在——

lines.en: : {i}My dorm! Be here in exactly twenty minutes. Thanks! Bye!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我的宿舍！正好二十分钟到。谢啦！拜！{/i}

lines.en: : Okay, see- oh. Oh, okay.
lines.zh: : 好的，回头见——哦。哦，好的。

lines.en: scene black
Now, do I think Makoto is {i}actually{/i} trapped in a wall? No. In fact, I’ve never really understood how that became a thing at all. I just like that it did.
lines.zh: 那么，我{i}真的{/i}觉得 Makoto 被卡在墙里了吗？没有。事实上，我一直没弄明白这到底是怎么变成一件事的。我只是很高兴它变成了。

lines.en: And {i}because{/i} I like that it did, I’m willing to give this a shot. I mean, what’s the worst that could possibly happen by just heading over to her dorm for the millionth time?
lines.zh: {i}既然{/i}我很高兴，也就愿意试一试。我是说，第一百万次跑去她宿舍，最糟又能怎样？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint1
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Okay. Well, yeah. This is actually pretty bad.
lines.zh: 好吧。嗯，是的。这个确实挺糟的。

lines.en: : What the fuck are you doing here?...Did {i}you{/i} put her up to this?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在这儿干什么？……是{i}你{/i}怂恿她这么干的？

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei. Could you go ahead and take a seat? I wasn’t really sure how to properly articulate and explain our current situation, so I did what I always do when I’m overwhelmed and made a PowerPoint about it.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sensei。你要不要先坐下？我不太确定该怎么恰当地表述和解释我们目前的处境，所以我做了我每次被逼到极限时都会做的事——做了个 PowerPoint。

lines.en: : This is an evil trick, Makoto. And not even remotely close to the first code red. Very close to the second, though, I will admit.
lines.zh: : 这是恶毒的圈套，Makoto。而且跟第一个红色警报差了十万八千里。不过我承认，跟第二个倒是很接近。

lines.en: : Is this a joke to you two? Who {i}else{/i} is in on it?
lines.zh: : 这对你们俩来说是玩笑吗？还有{i}谁{/i}参与了？

lines.en: : Are Sara and Haruka about to walk through the door next? Because they also had no trouble rallying against me the {i}last{/i} time I had to be the only sane person in the room.
lines.zh: : 接下来是不是 Sara 和 Haruka 也要推门进来了？{i}上一次{/i}我是屋里唯一清醒的人时，她们俩也毫不费力地联合起来对付我了。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint2
: That’s a question for Makoto, not me. I’m only here because I was duped. Same as you, most likely.
lines.zh: : 这个问题该问 Makoto，不是我。我来只是因为被骗了。大概跟你一样。

lines.en: : No, Akira. I came here to bring her {i}back{/i} because I’m much more comfortable with my daughter staying at my house where I can be sure she isn’t fucking her {i}teacher.{/i} This is a thing {i}normal{/i} people care about.
lines.zh: : 不，Akira。我是来带她{i}回去{/i}的，因为我更放心让女儿待在我家，那样我才能确保她没有在跟她的{i}老师{/i}上床。{i}正常人{/i}都会在意这种事。

lines.en: : I figured this would happen when I didn’t go home after my appointment today. So I threw this all together in the time between those two things and manufactured an impromptu family meeting of sorts.
lines.zh: : 我今天看完诊没回家，就猜到会这样。所以我在那两件事之间赶出了这些，凑成了一场临时的家庭会议之类的东西。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint3
: He is not {i}family,{/i} Makoto. {i}We{/i} are family. {i}Miku{/i} is family. And if he {i}were{/i} family, it would somehow make this even {i}more{/i} terrible since incest is only good in porn.
lines.zh: : 他不是{i}家人{/i}，Makoto。{i}我们{/i}才是家人。{i}Miku{/i} 也是家人。如果他{i}算{/i}家人，那这件事就{i}更{/i}糟了，因为乱伦只在色情片里才好看。

lines.en: : Let the record show that I do agree that this is terrible and that I’m only kind of not the target audience for this presentation as well. Just more willing to be convinced.
lines.zh: : 请记录在案：我确实同意这很糟，而且我也勉强算不是这场演讲的目标受众。只是比较容易被说服而已。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint4
: You know, you {i}could{/i} just leave her alone and {i}not{/i} ruin her fucking life. That’s always an option too, you sick, disgusting piece of shit.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你也{i}可以{/i}干脆离她远点，{i}别{/i}毁了她的人生。这也一直是个选项，你这个人渣、恶心的混蛋。

lines.en: : You can’t say I didn’t try to warn you, Maki.
lines.zh: : 你不能说我没试着警告过你，Maki。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint5
: {i}Warn{/i} me?! You thinking {i}warning{/i} me makes this any less-
lines.zh: : {i}警告我{/i}？！你以为{i}警告过{/i}我，这件事就不那么——

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint6

: Hi. Presenter here. {i}Loving{/i} the enthusiasm so far but, if it’s not a problem, I’d like to get the ball rolling so this isn’t just an open discussion about what I should be allowed to do with my body. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗨。演讲者在这里。到目前为止大家热情高涨，我很{i}喜欢{/i}，不过如果没问题的话，我想正式开始，这样就不至于变成一场关于我该怎么处置自己身体的开放式讨论。谢谢。

lines.en: : Your body belongs to me until you’re in college and that is final.
lines.zh: : 在你上大学之前，你的身体归我管，就这么定了。

lines.en: : Which is unreasonable for a {i}number{/i} of reasons that I hope to shine a light on with my presentation today. So I ask that you remain calm and-
lines.zh: : 这在{i}很多{/i}方面都不合理，我希望今天的演讲能把它们说清楚。所以请你保持冷静，并且——

lines.en: : Don’t you dare fucking bring that chair closer to me, Akira!
lines.zh: : 你他妈敢把那把椅子再往我这边挪，Akira！

lines.en: : And treat each other with the same respect that you wish to be treated with. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 还有，用你希望别人对待你的方式对待彼此。谢谢。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint7
: There’s a glare on the screen when I sit further away. I’m just trying to see the PowerPoint.
lines.zh: : 我坐远了屏幕会反光。我只是想看看那个 PowerPoint。

lines.en: : Oh, you mean the PowerPoint about why it’s okay for you to fuck my daughter? {i}That{/i} PowerPoint? You’re excited for {i}that?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，你是说那个讲你为什么可以操我女儿的 PowerPoint？{i}那个{/i} PowerPoint？你很期待？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say I’m {i}excited.{/i} Just curious about how Makoto is going to try and dig herself out of the colossal hole she created by blatantly confessing everything to you.
lines.zh: : 谈不上{i}期待{/i}。只是好奇 Makoto 要怎么从她自己挖的巨坑里爬出来——她可是把一切都毫不遮掩地跟你坦白了。

lines.en: : At least she was brave enough to do that instead of spouting a bunch of vague nonsense and getting {i}me{/i} to do the heavy lifting like a certain {i}someone.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少她有胆子这么做，而不是像{i}某个人{/i}那样，说一堆含糊的废话，让{i}我{/i}自己去拼凑。

lines.en: : You are still mad and that is fair. I am not a good person.
lines.zh: : 你还在生气，这很公平。我不是好人。

lines.en: : I hope you get hit by a plane.
lines.zh: : 我希望你被飞机撞死。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint8
: Cool! So, on that note, I guess I’ll begin.
lines.zh: : 好！那么，就以此为契机，我开始吧。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint9

: From an outsider’s perspective, I’m sure this whole thing seems pretty cut and dry. High school student. Predatory teacher. It’s a tale as old as time and one that we’ve all seen on the news time and time again.
lines.zh: : 从外人的角度看，这件事大概一目了然。女高中生。捕食成性的老师。这是个老掉牙的故事，我们在新闻里已经见过一遍又一遍。

lines.en: : The reason for this, however, is that it’s easy to sensationalize because society has instilled within us a set of morals that we can not bend without being labeled as insane or {i}immoral.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但之所以会这样，是因为这种事很容易被煽情化，因为社会灌输给我们一套道德规范，我们一旦弯曲它，就会被贴上疯狂或{i}不道德{/i}的标签。

lines.en: : {size=-5}What society {i}fails{/i} to understand, though, is that each and every one of us is guided by our own moral code shaped by personal experiences and perception and that adhering to a set of rules forced upon us by those who believe they know what’s best for us deprives us of the freedom we need to live happily.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}但社会{i}没{/i}想明白的是，我们每个人都受自己的道德准则指引，而它由个人经历和认知塑造；一味遵守那些自认为知道什么对我们最好的人强加给我们的规则，会剥夺我们幸福生活所需要的自由。{/size}

lines.en: : Oh, good. We’re already at the part where you make me feel stupid and insignificant because of how smart and articulate you are. It can only get better from here, can’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦，真好。已经到了这个环节——用你的聪明和能说会道让我觉得自己又蠢又微不足道。接下来只会更精彩，是吧？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint10
: {i}Context is key,{/i} Mom. And sometimes, things that {i}appear{/i} to be wrong from one person’s point of view only appear that way at all because they lack a proper view of the big picture.
lines.zh: : {i}关键在于前因后果{/i}，妈。有些事在某人看来是错的，之所以{i}看起来{/i}错，只是因为他们没能看清全局。

lines.en: : For example, if one of Dad’s friends saw you getting railed at a bar by some random guy without knowing about your “open relationship,” they’d have assumed you were a cheating whore. But you’re not.
lines.zh: : 比如说，如果爸爸的某个朋友在酒吧里看见你被某个陌生男人从后面干，而他不知道你们的「开放式关系」，他会以为你是个出轨的荡妇。但你不是。

lines.en: : You’re just a regular one.
lines.zh: : 你只是个普通的荡妇。

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe don’t insult her like that, Makoto. {i}You’re{/i} lacking context too, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 好了。也许别这么侮辱她，Makoto。{i}你自己{/i}也缺前因后果，不是吗？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint11
: That’s absolutely correct, Sensei. Because, as the projector shows, expectations rarely fit reality. Which means that what we see is what we {i}get,{/i} but it isn’t what we {i}have.{/i}
lines.zh: : 完全正确，老师。因为正如投影所示，期待很少与现实吻合。这意味着所见即{i}所得{/i}，但所见并非{i}所有{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint12

: Now, we’re all in agreement that sex is awesome. Right? It’s humanity’s pastime. And it {i}used{/i} to be free until religion reshaped what is now the modern day landscape of interpersonal intimacy.
lines.zh: : 那么，我们都同意性很棒，对吧？这是人类的消遣。而且在宗教重塑了如今人际亲密关系的版图之前，它{i}曾经{/i}是免费的。

lines.en: : Even {i}that{/i} varies from culture to culture, though. And sometimes on a much smaller scale than you’d imagine.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}这{/i}在不同文化之间也有差异。有时差异的尺度比你想象的要小得多。

lines.en: : In Japan alone, prefectures have never been on the same page when it comes to taking action on this. Which is why even the national age of consent is contested in some municipalities that see it as too low.
lines.zh: : 光是在日本，各都道府县在这件事上从来没有统一过立场。所以连国家的同意年龄，在一些认为它定得太低的市町村都有争议。

lines.en: : {size=-4}The key argument you’ll hear when this is brought up most of the time is that anyone under that age is not mentally mature enough to make decisions that, sometimes consequently, result in things like teenage pregnancy or, in Miku’s case, physical harm.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}提起这件事时，你最常听到的核心论点是：低于那个年龄的人心智不够成熟，无法做出那些有时会导致少女怀孕、或者像 Miku 那样造成身体伤害的决定。{/size}

lines.en: : But I ask you this — am {i}I{/i} among those you’d deem mentally immature?
lines.zh: : 但我要问你——{i}我{/i}也属于你认为心智不成熟的那些人吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Yes, Makoto. You are.
lines.zh: : 是。是的，Makoto。你就是。

lines.en: : Then I will counter with the fact that so is Sensei and that none of this actually matters anyway because of slide two.
lines.zh: : 那我反驳：Sensei 也是。而且因为第二张幻灯片，这些其实都不重要。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint13
: Oh my fucking-
lines.zh: : 我操你——

lines.en: : The world is broken, everything is fucked, and you are quite literally asking me to do the impossible by waiting to be in college before I have sex with my teacher when I can never {i}actually{/i} grow up.
lines.zh: : 世界是坏的，一切都完蛋了，而你实际上是在要求我做一件不可能的事——在我永远{i}长不大{/i}的前提下，要我等到上大学再和我的老师上床。

lines.en: : I’m getting you a new psychiatrist.
lines.zh: : 我要给你换一个精神科医生。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint14

: I know how it sounds, okay?! I didn’t believe it either until I had no choice {i}but{/i} to believe it. And now I have no idea how old I even {i}am{/i} because this has been going on for an indeterminate amount of time!
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很离谱，好吗？！我自己也不信，直到我{i}别无选择{/i}只能相信。而现在我连自己{i}多大了{/i}都不知道，因为这一切已经持续了无法计算的时间！

lines.en: : Even then, though, I’ve been conscious of it long enough that I likely {i}would{/i} be in college by now if time {i}did{/i} progress!
lines.zh: : 即便如此，我意识到这件事的时间已经够久了，如果时间{i}真的{/i}在走，我现在大概{i}已经{/i}上大学了！

lines.en: : Which means I {i}have{/i} mentally matured to the point where I’d legally be allowed to make decisions like this {i}without{/i} your parental input. Which is great, because sex could be important to saving us all!
lines.zh: : 这意味着我的心智{i}已经{/i}成熟到足以在法律上{i}无需{/i}你作为家长的许可就做出这样的决定。这很好，因为性可能对我们拯救所有人至关重要！

lines.en: : From what?!
lines.zh: : 从什么手里拯救？！

lines.en: : I don’t really know! We haven’t figured that part out yet!
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道！那部分我们还没搞明白！

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint15
: What the fuck have you done to my daughter, Akira? What pretentious bullshit have you fed her that has turned her from a brilliant little girl into a fucking conspiracy theorist?
lines.zh: : 你到底对我女儿做了什么，Akira？你给她灌了什么自以为是的狗屁，把她从一个聪明的小姑娘变成了一个该死的阴谋论者？

lines.en: : I know how it sounds, but she’s right. We {i}are{/i} caught in a timeloop. And you’re somehow now in on it and breaking a long-standing rule of only younger girls gaining such awareness.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很离谱，但她是对的。我们{i}被困{/i}在时间循环里。而不知怎么的，你现在也知情了，还打破了一条长久以来的规则——只有年轻女孩才能获得这种认知。

lines.en: : Oh, how convenient. I find out you’re fucking my daughter and I’m now special and gifted enough to be sucked into your little sex cult where you’ve convinced a bunch of teenagers you’re God. I can’t wait.
lines.zh: : 哦，真巧啊。我刚发现你在操我女儿，我立马就特殊又天赋异禀到被吸进你那个小小的性爱邪教——你在里头让一群青少年相信你是神。我等不及了。

lines.en: : I’m no god, Maki. I’m just confused and lost and want to get out of this. And so does Makoto. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 我不是神，Maki。我只是困惑、迷失，想逃出去。Makoto 也想。算是吧。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint16
: Kind of?
lines.zh: : 算是吧？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint17
: Believe it or not, I’m {i}happier{/i} here. I don’t have to {i}worry{/i} about the pressure of getting into a prestigious college or what I’ll do when I grow up.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，我在这里{i}更快乐{/i}。我不用为考进名校的压力{i}发愁{/i}，也不用为长大以后要做什么发愁。

lines.en: : I can just live my life the way I want. And sometimes that includes reading or studying, sure. But it also includes a ton of recreational sex because, to hearken back to an earlier slide, it’s awesome and fun.
lines.zh: : 我可以按自己想要的方式过日子。当然，其中也包括读书或学习。但其中也包括大量的娱乐性性爱，因为——回到前面那张幻灯片——性很棒，也很有趣。

lines.en: : {size=-4}And if all of this is part of some cycle, perhaps one visually represented in a PowerPoint right now, forced abstinence will do nothing but subject me to an eternity of misery that, let’s face it, I’d absolutely go over your head to break out of anyway.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}如果这一切都是某个循环的一部分——现在正被某个 PowerPoint 直观地呈现着——那么强迫我禁欲只会让我遭受永恒的不幸，而说实话，那种不幸我肯定会绕过你去打破的。{/size}

lines.en: : Yes, you’ve made that very apparent. But I’m not going to believe that this is all part of some time-conspiracy thing just because the two of you put a little slide-show together.
lines.zh: : 是，你把这点表现得很清楚。但我不会因为你们俩凑了一小段幻灯片，就相信这全是什么时间阴谋。

lines.en: : You’ve been manipulated by a man you admire, Makoto. And Akira has poisoned your mind into something fragile enough to believe something so incredibly fucking stupid.
lines.zh: : 你被一个你崇拜的男人操纵了，Makoto。Akira 毒害了你的思想，让它脆弱到能相信这么他妈愚蠢透顶的东西。

lines.en: : Mom, let’s be real. Do you really think {i}Sensei{/i} would be able to convince {i}me{/i} about this? I’m way smarter than him and we all know it. Correct?
lines.zh: : 妈，说实话。你真觉得 {i}Sensei{/i} 能说服{i}我{/i}相信这些？我可比他聪明多了，我们都知道。对吧？

lines.en: : She’s right. If anything, Makoto would be the one convincing {i}me{/i} that this is the fate we’ve fallen into.
lines.zh: : 她说得对。要说也是 Makoto 说服{i}我{/i}，让我相信这就是我们落入的命运。

lines.en: : Oh, great. Then she has a degenerative brain disease and it is progressing so quickly that her grip on reality is now all but gone. How convenient. {i}Again.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。那她是得了脑部退化疾病，而且恶化得飞快，她对现实的把握现在几乎全没了。真巧。{i}又一次{/i}。

lines.en: : Now, I obviously knew you wouldn’t believe any of this. Which is why I’ve {i}also{/i} enlisted the help of an uninvolved third and fourth party who may now enter the room with their respective testimonials. Girls!
lines.zh: : 我当然早就知道你不会相信这些。所以我还{i}请了{/i}两位无关的第三方和第四方来帮忙，她们现在可以带着各自的证词进来了。姑娘们！

lines.en: scene black
scene makotopowerpoint18
: Hi, Mrs. Miyamura. Hi, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 您好，Miyamura 太太。嗨，Sensei。

lines.en: : Sup, porn lady. Long time, no see.
lines.zh: : 咋样啊，色情店大姐。好久不见。

lines.en: : Wha...so you two are in on this too? {i}Why?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 什……所以你们俩也参与了？{i}为什么？……{/i}

lines.en: : What do you get out of going along with something so insane? Is he {i}paying{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 跟着一起搞这种疯事，你们图什么？他{i}给钱{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint19
: Nope! I’m rich. Sensei would never be able to afford me if I didn’t throw myself at him free of charge.
lines.zh: : 不！我有钱。要不是我免费倒贴他，Sensei 根本养不起我。

lines.en: : Makoto’s payin’ me in food to show up for this shit but, other than that, I ain’t gotten anything.
lines.zh: : Makoto 给我吃的当报酬，让我来露这个脸，除此之外我什么都没拿到。

lines.en: : Ayane, Yumi — in your own words, could you please explain the nature of our universe to my mother? In simple terms though, please.
lines.zh: : Ayane、Yumi——能请你们用自己的话，向我妈解释一下我们这个宇宙的本质吗？不过请说得简单点。

lines.en: : Well, basically, we’re trapped in a never-ending year of high-school where only a select few can actually talk about it without glitching out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，基本上，我们被困在一个永无止境的高中年级里，只有极少数人能真的谈论这件事而不出故障。

lines.en: : And once every few months, the sky gets all weird and we’re transported to a different part of the year where pretty much everybody else has no idea all that crazy shit even happened in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而且每隔几个月，天空就会变得很怪，然后我们被传送到这一年里的另一个时段，而其他人基本上完全不知道那些疯狂的事发生过。

lines.en: : You’re the first adult we’ve ever had apart from Sensei! And with Nodoka and Uta in the {i}loop{/i} now too, our numbers are really growing all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 除了 Sensei 之外，您是我们有过的第一个成年人！再加上 Nodoka 和 Uta 现在也{i}知情{/i}了，我们的人数突然涨起来了。

lines.en: : Then...have you two...{i}also{/i} been groomed by this guy?
lines.zh: : 那么……你们俩……{i}也{/i}是被这个人诱奸的吗？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint20
: She has. I haven’t.
lines.zh: : 她是。我不是。

lines.en: : I like to think that {i}I’m{/i} the one who groomed him.
lines.zh: : 我更愿意认为，是{i}我{/i}诱奸了他。

lines.en: : You’re kidding...it’s gone {i}this{/i} far?...It’s {i}this{/i} normal now?
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吧……已经到{i}这一步{/i}了？……现在已经{i}这么{/i}正常了？

lines.en: : If you have any questions, I can leave the room with Sensei and you can cross-reference our answers once we return to further prove that we’re not making this up.
lines.zh: : 如果你有任何疑问，我可以和 Sensei 离开房间，等我们回来时你可以交叉比对我们的答案，进一步证明我们不是在编故事。

lines.en: : The world really is broken. And I would like to use that as an excuse to continue living life the way I want to live without having to argue about it every day.
lines.zh: : 这个世界真的是坏的。我想以此为由，继续按我想要的方式生活，而不必每天为此争吵。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint21
: Makoto’s been really helpful, Mrs. Miyamura. Like, I like to think that I’m the leader of the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad, but she’s got a pretty equal hold of the reins at this point.
lines.zh: : Makoto 帮了很大的忙，Miyamura 太太。比如，我自认是天台末日小队的队长，但到这一步，她手里的缰绳跟我的差不多一样紧。

lines.en: : Been a lot more bearable ever since all this shit started too. Used to just be the annoying girl who always tried to make me do my homework and shit and I actually don’t hate her now. So that’s cool.
lines.zh: : 自从这些破事开始之后，日子也好过多了。以前她就是那个老是逼我做作业的讨厌女生，现在我居然不讨厌她了。还挺酷的。

lines.en: : And you don’t...find it odd that...she and Akira...that {i}you{/i} and Akira...
lines.zh: : 那你不觉得……奇怪吗……她和 Akira……{i}你{/i}和 Akira……

lines.en: : I am biased and have been in love with Sensei since before all this timeloop stuff started, so I’m not the right person to ask.
lines.zh: : 我有偏见，而且在这一堆时间循环的事开始之前我就爱上 Sensei 了，所以你问错人了。

lines.en: : And I {i}do{/i} think it’s creepy as shit, so I ain’t the person to ask either.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}觉得这恶心透顶，所以我也不是你该问的人。

lines.en: : I didn’t bring them here to weigh in on that part. Their presence was mostly just to confirm the whole “broken world” aspect.
lines.zh: : 我请她们来不是为了对那部分发表意见。她们在场主要只是为了证实「世界是坏的」这一点。

lines.en: : Well, they’ve done their part and I’d like them to leave now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，她们的任务完成了，我希望她们现在可以离开。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint22
: When do I get my food?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候能拿到吃的？

lines.en: : Come on, Yumi. Let’s let Makoto wrap her PowerPoint up and I’ll order us a pizza.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Yumi。让 Makoto 把她的 PowerPoint 收个尾，我来给咱们点个披萨。

lines.en: scene black
: Bet. I get my own, right? Cause I ain’t gonna share when you probably want something gay like olives or some shit.
lines.zh: : 成交。我自己要一整个，对吧？因为你大概会想要橄榄之类的同性恋玩意儿，我可不跟你分。

lines.en: : You can have {i}ten{/i} pizzas thanks to my never-ending quest to spite my dad. And yes, I am going to get olives and there is nothing you can do to stop me.
lines.zh: : 你要{i}十个{/i}披萨都行，多亏我为了气我爸而永不停歇的征途。没错，我就是要加橄榄，你拦不住我。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint23
: So, to recap what we’ve learned today — the world is broken. But even if it wasn’t, there would still be a plethora of reasons for you to accept my relationship with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那么，总结一下今天学到的东西——世界是坏的。但就算不是，也依然有无数理由让你接受我和 Sensei 的关系。

lines.en: : That said, I do not wish to ask for your blessing. Just that you accept the perplexing state of the universe and stop blaming yourself for all of the things we-
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我并不想请求你的祝福。只是希望你能接受宇宙这令人费解的状态，别再为我们——

lines.en: : {i}I am finding you a new psychiatrist.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我要给你找一个精神科医生。{/i}

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint24
: Keep your hands off my fucking daughter.
lines.zh: : 把你那双手从我他妈的女儿身上拿开。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint25
scene makotopowerpoint26
: Well, that went about as well as I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，进展跟我预料的差不多。

lines.en: : You mean horrible?
lines.zh: : 你是说糟透了？

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint27
: I wouldn’t say {i}horrible.{/i} I mean, she {i}did{/i} leave us together in a room that she knows we’re probably going to have more sex in. So that’s a plus.
lines.zh: : 我不会说{i}糟透了{/i}。我是说，她明知道我们大概还会在这个房间里再做一次，{i}还是{/i}把我们俩留在这儿了。所以这算加分项。

lines.en: : It was a good idea getting Yumi and Ayane to {i}testify.{/i} But I imagine Maki probably just thinks they’re in on the plot to bomb her thoughts now too.
lines.zh: : 让 Yumi 和 Ayane 来{i}作证{/i}是个好主意。但我想 Maki 大概只会觉得她们现在也参与了给她洗脑的阴谋。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint28
: Yes, and I imagine she’ll {i}continue{/i} to think that way until she’s {i}forced{/i} to believe like I was.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想她会{i}一直{/i}这么想，直到像我当初那样{i}被迫{/i}相信。

lines.en: : Either that or she {i}does{/i} get reset and I can just hope and pray that everything I confessed to her is subsequently purged from her mind.
lines.zh: : 要么就是她{i}真{/i}被重置了，那我只能祈祷我向她坦白的一切随后都会从她脑子里被清除。

lines.en: : How are you feeling about all of this?
lines.zh: : 你对这一切感觉如何？

lines.en: : What, like, having her know about us? Or having her in on the loops?
lines.zh: : 什么，是指让她知道我们的事？还是让她知情循环的事？

lines.en: : Actually, I guess the intent behind the question doesn’t really matter when I hate both of those things.
lines.zh: : 其实，既然这两样我都讨厌，你问这个问题的意图也就无所谓了。

lines.en: : You hate having her {i}aware?{/i} Why?
lines.zh: : 你讨厌她{i}知情{/i}？为什么？

lines.en: : Because it’s like she’s chaperoning a field trip I didn’t invite her to. I don’t want my {i}mom{/i} in on the world where I get to have unlimited sex with my teacher and skip doing my homework some nights.
lines.zh: : 因为这就好像她在一场我没邀请她参加的郊游上当监护老师。我不想让我{i}妈{/i}进入那个我可以和老师无限做爱、还能偶尔不做作业的世界。

lines.en: : You’re not skipping your homework, Makoto. I don’t believe that for one second.
lines.zh: : 你没有不做作业，Makoto。我一点都不信。

lines.en: scene makotopowerpoint29
: But I {i}could.{/i} And that’s really what matters at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}可以{/i}不做。说到底，这才是重点。

lines.en: : So, what now? We just...sit around and wait for something traumatizing to happen to her?
lines.zh: : 那么，接下来呢？我们就……干等着有什么创伤性的事发生在她身上？

lines.en: : I guess. Do you think she’ll see Big Boi?
lines.zh: : 大概吧。你觉得她会见到 Big Boi 吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Ahh, forget it. Just take my clothes off and tell me you liked my PowerPoint.
lines.zh: : 啊，算了。把我的衣服脱了，然后告诉我你喜欢我的 PowerPoint。

lines.en: : That’s the single most Makoto thing you’ve ever said to me.
lines.zh: : 这是你跟我说过的最「Makoto」的一句话。

lines.en: : I know. But where do you think you’re-
lines.zh: : 我知道。可你以为你要去——

lines.en: : Locking the door for plausible deniability if Maki forgot something and tries to come back in.
lines.zh: : 把门锁上，这样万一 Maki 落了东西想回来，我们也能有合理的推脱。

lines.en: : I’ve never been more attracted to you in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没像现在这样被你吸引过。

lines.en: Do I think tonight’s presentation worked?
lines.zh: 我觉得今晚的演讲奏效了吗？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.en: But do I think that it {i}might{/i} in time?
lines.zh: 但我觉得它迟早{i}会{/i}奏效吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 会。

lines.en: Because we have plenty of it here — which gives the cracks forming in Maki’s psyche plenty of time to splinter and ultimately force her to shatter when her frame can no longer bear them.
lines.zh: 因为我们这里有的是时间——这给了 Maki 心里正在形成的裂缝足够的时间去裂开，最终在她的框架再也无法承受时，逼得她彻底碎掉。

lines.en: And when that happens, Makoto and I will be there to pick up the pieces.
lines.zh: 而到那时，Makoto 和我会去把碎片捡起来。

lines.en: Well, {i}I’ll{/i} be there to pick up the pieces. Makoto will be there to say, “I told you so.”
lines.zh: 好吧，是「{i}我{/i}」会去把碎片捡起来。Makoto 会在那儿说「我早就告诉过你」。

lines.en: But just when Maki hits her lowest, I’ll have a dustpan waiting to scoop her back up — with an empty spot in my pocket reserved just for her.
lines.zh: 但就在 Maki 跌到最低谷时，我会拿着簸箕等着把她重新收起来——我口袋里还专门给她留了个空位。

lines.en: In time, I’ll mix her with the rest.
lines.zh: 总有一天，我会把她和其他人混在一起。

lines.en: And with those fragments, I will make something beautiful.
lines.zh: 用那些碎片，我会做出一件美丽的东西。

lines.en: A vase.
lines.zh: 一只花瓶。

lines.en: A vessel to hold my flowers.
lines.zh: 一个用来插我的花的容器。

lines.en: Every day, they grow some more.
lines.zh: 它们每天都在长大一点。
